summary: Marketing manager with ten years across B2B software and consumer retail. I set the channel mix and budget, build small teams that run campaigns end to end, and report revenue impact to the executive team every quarter.

experiences.description: Outdoor gear retailer with 40 stores in Texas and an online shop.

achievements.text: Own the annual marketing plan and $2.4M budget across paid social, search, email, print and in-store campaigns
Moved a third of the print budget into paid social and email; online revenue grew 38% over two years with no increase in total spend
Launched a loyalty program with the CRM and store teams that reached 180,000 members in its first year
Built a team of five covering performance, content, CRM and design, and hired three of them
Ran demand generation for the mid-market product with a $900K annual budget across paid search, LinkedIn, webinars and events
Started a monthly webinar series with product managers that became the largest source of sales-accepted leads
Agreed a lead scoring model with sales leadership, cutting leads returned as unqualified by about half
Managed two specialists and an external paid media agency against a cost per opportunity target
Planned and ran Google Ads and Facebook campaigns for eight local and regional clients
Set up conversion tracking and monthly reports so clients could see cost per lead by channel
